comment: True silhouettes (#150), written by `packbuilder silhouettes` and `packbuilder silhouette-review`; review on the contact sheets in build/pack-art/<pack id>/silhouettes/. Per species: the reference photo and isolation seed, the recipe's version, the picture's SHA-256 (its file in <cache>/art/silhouettes/), its size, what the recipe noticed (the bird's size in the isolated picture, holes filled, sides the frame cuts) and the review: pending, approved (in the pack), rejected (it stays out until art.silhouette.reference in overrides.json gives another bird) or gap (no silhouette; the app keeps its glyph; why).
